title: Printed work order shows Unassigned for an empty side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have a first work order for that customer with Labor reading "Unassigned" and Parts set to sales rep B.
  • Have a second work order with Labor set to sales rep A and Parts reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the first work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's menu.
  2. Click Print Work Order and read the Sales Representative row of the printout.
  3. Open the second work order.
  4. Open the work order's menu.
  5. Click Print Work Order and read the Sales Representative row of the printout.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The row reads "[sales rep B's name] (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)".

Step 3:

  • The second work order opens.

Step 4:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 5:

  • The row reads "Unassigned (Parts) · [sales rep A's name] (Labor)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11270 (Story 6, Print both representatives on the work order)

  • S6-R3: “When one side is empty, the row reads "Devon Whitfield (Parts) · Unassigned (Labor)" or "Unassigned (Parts) · Elliot Brennan (Labor)", the same wording as the work order log (S7-R3).”
